parsed.name: 三轴运动平台示例装置
parsed.description: 这是一个基于 PLC 控制逻辑的三轴运动平台示例装置，包含模拟的 X、Y、Z 运动以及若干离散状态位。它主要用于实验室或束线控制系统中演示和测试运动控制、限位行为、状态切换以及与上位控制系统的集成。
parsed.description_en: This is an example PLC-controlled 3-axis motion stage with simulated X, Y, and Z motion and several discrete state positions. It is mainly used in laboratory or beamline control environments to demonstrate and test motion control, limit behavior, state changes, and integration with higher-level control systems.
